stem.text: A straight tube is closed at one end and has a loudspeaker positioned at the open end. The frequency of the loudspeaker is initially very low and is increased slowly. A series of loudness maxima are heard. The stationary wave which gives the first maximum has a node at the closed end and an antinode at the open end. The frequency of the loudspeaker is $f_{1}$ when the first maximum is heard.
What is the frequency of the loudspeaker when the fourth maximum is heard?
